Theorem
[heat-kernel differential Harnack on complete manifolds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0352, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0355 ↗ thm:chow-ii-ch16-linear-entropy-formula ↗ cor:chow-ii-ch16-heat-integrability 1. ch16:16.28\group Heat Harnack

If $M$ is complete with $\operatorname {Rc}\ge 0$ and $H$ is the heat kernel, then, writing $H=(4\pi au )^{-n/2}e^{-f}$, \[ au (2\Delta f-| abla f|^2)+f-n\le 0, \qquad \mathcal W_{ m lin}(f, au )\le 0. \]
Proof

\sketch For $v_H=( au (2\Delta f-| abla f|^2)+f-n)H$ one has

\[ (\partial _ au -\Delta )v_H=-2 au \left(\left| abla ^2f- rac{g}{2 au } ight|^2 +\operatorname {Rc}( abla f, abla f) ight)H\le 0. \]

Pairing with a nonnegative backward heat solution and using the parametrix to show that the pairing tends to zero as $ au \downarrow 0$ gives $v_H\le 0$.

□
